svg.title: The webhook sender in production, from kustomize build
svg.desc: The webhook sender in production, from kustomize build: 4 nodes, 4 connections. 2 workloads and 2 objects around them, imported from the output of kustomize build. Solid arrows are calls to a Service, and dashed arrows are configuration the pods read. Nodes: - webhook-sender (Deployment, 3 replicas, port 9090), service - webhook-redeliver (CronJob), function - webhook-config (ConfigMap), storage - webhook-queue (Secret), secret Connections: - webhook-sender to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-sender to webhook-queue (dashed, identity line): reads - webhook-redeliver to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-redeliver to webhook-queue (dashed, identity line): reads
